groups.subject: Same urban street daylight scene (Cityscapes-like) with consistent viewpoint, vehicles, pedestrians, buildings, and road across all panels
groups.prompt:
You are a scientific illustrator generating images for an academic paper figure.

Generate ONE single image composed of 3 EQUAL-SIZED sub-panels arranged horizontally (side-by-side) with clear white gaps (about 20-30 pixels) between them.

Subject: Same urban street daylight scene (Cityscapes-like) with consistent viewpoint, vehicles, pedestrians, buildings, and road across all panels

Panel 1 (Left): A realistic natural scene photograph of an urban street in daylight with buildings, road, and a few vehicles/pedestrians; natural colors, photographic lighting; no overlays, no bounding boxes, no annotations, no text.
Panel 2 (Middle): The same kind of street photo as the input, with a semi-transparent semantic segmentation overlay: distinct solid colors per class forming regions (e.g., road, building, car, person), clean boundaries, typical segmentation mask appearance; no legend, no text.
Panel 3 (Right): A standalone segmentation-style mask image: only confident regions are colored with distinct class colors while the rest of the image is gray or transparent-looking; crisp region shapes; no text, no legend, no photo background required (mask-focused).

CRITICAL Constraints:
- All panels MUST depict the EXACT SAME scene/subject for visual consistency (same viewpoint, same objects, same composition).
- Each panel MUST be a SQUARE or near-square frame of EQUAL size.
- Content within each panel should be CENTERED and NOT stretched. If the natural aspect ratio differs, add white padding (letterbox/pillarbox) to maintain the square frame without distortion.
- Do NOT add any text, labels, numbers, legends, watermarks, or captions inside the image.
- Pure visual data only - no annotations.
- Use solid pure white (#FFFFFF) background and pure white gaps between panels.
- The white gaps between panels must be clearly visible and consistent width.

groups.subject: Abstract icon representing image-level labels (multi-label tag/list card)
groups.prompt:
You are a scientific illustrator generating images for an academic paper figure.

Generate ONE single image showing: A minimal flat-design tag/list icon representing image-level labels: a small rounded card with several bullet lines and tiny tag symbols; clean vector style, light background with dark gray strokes and a small accent color; no readable text characters.

CRITICAL Constraints:
- The image should be SQUARE or near-square.
- Content should be CENTERED with white padding if needed to maintain aspect ratio without distortion.
- Do NOT add any text, labels, numbers, legends, watermarks, or captions inside the image.
- Use solid pure white (#FFFFFF) background.
- Clean, minimal scientific illustration style.
